descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you risk averse? Do you know how to maintain independence and objectivity? We are looking for someone like that who can:

•  act as a compliance and operational risk control subject-matter expert for a centralized group supervising electronic communication activity, supporting them in managing risk
•  perform first-line-of-defense activities in relation to consequential risks
•  ensure risk frameworks are designed well and operating effectively
•  deliver monthly reports that shed light on risk profiles in reference to electronic review for the market areas
•  provide business management with controls, tools, frameworks , information and insights required to manage risk in relation to electronic communication activity
